cohort: The study included 13,958 pregnant French women from a large dataset collected between 2012 and 2018.
finding: Smoking in women with hyperglycemia first diagnosed in pregnancy (H1inP) could mask the risk of maternal hyperglycemia for large-for-gestational-age (LGA) babies, though these women still face increased risks of other adverse outcomes like hypertensive disorders.
mod_finding: Hyperglycemia first diagnosed in pregnancy (H1inP) was associated with higher rates of caesarean sections.
